verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an audit log that records who changed the cap table, what changed, when, and under what authorization. The only nearby items are a support article titled "How to View the Timeline", with no content showing it is a change log; advanced permissions over who can view or modify data, which is access control rather than logging; and board resolutions. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
